item.title: Looking for someone to do my R-Studio statistics course for me
item.description: Hiii! I study agriculture at Uni and we‘re doing a course using Basic statictic calculations or R-Studio. It’s nothing crazy but I have figured that I struggle a lot more than necessary and it gets a little time consuming. We’re at lesson 6 of roundabout twenty. The lessons have to be filled into an online form, therefore I’d be just asking for the solutions and filling them in myself. There are no limitations in tries or time during the lessons, we only have due dates. The tests are in German, however I’d be willing to translate them :) I’d be willing to give the person a remuneration of 15€! Thanks guys!!
